# Ordered frozen feature equations

All predictors use sigmoid(sum beta_j phi_j). No hidden scaling is fitted. The exact phi_j order for every family is the explicit list concatenation in run.features.

Selected reference order: 1, normalizedEVdifference, probability-.5, gain/loss sign, safeRisk, knownFeedback, knownFeedback*entropy, knownFeedback*complete, logit(Beta1,1historyMean), previousChoiceCentered*hasHistory.
